boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct S&T study environments, from reservable collaboration rooms to staffed academic-support spaces.

cards.title: Library Room 327
cards.subtitle: Curtis Laws Wilson Library • third-floor meeting room
cards.notes: Reserve this four-person room for a focused working session; use its whiteboard wall and shared screen for planning or review.
cards.short_summary: A reservable third-floor room built around a whiteboard wall and shared display.
cards.evidence_claim: Library Room 327 has a table, four chairs, a whiteboard wall, a large monitor, and ClickShare; its key is collected at the circulation desk after reservation.
cards.access_notes: Reserve the room first; the reservation holder or group member checks out and returns the key at the circulation desk.

cards.title: Innovation Lab Room 104
cards.subtitle: Innovation Lab • shared meeting space
cards.notes: Use this named shared room when your group needs a bookable campus setting; arrange the plan before opening the Outlook calendar.
cards.short_summary: One of the Innovation Lab’s student-reservable shared meeting rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Innovation Lab Room 104 is listed among shared meeting spaces that students can reserve through the Outlook Calendar.
cards.access_notes: Students reserve this shared meeting space through the Outlook Calendar.

cards.title: Innovation Lab Room 105
cards.subtitle: Innovation Lab • shared meeting space
cards.notes: Book this distinct shared room for a small project meeting, then reset furniture and leave time for the next reservation.
cards.short_summary: A separate student-reservable Innovation Lab room for planned group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Innovation Lab Room 105 is listed among shared meeting spaces that students can reserve through the Outlook Calendar.
cards.access_notes: Students reserve this shared meeting space through the Outlook Calendar.

cards.title: Innovation Lab Room 110
cards.subtitle: Innovation Lab • shared meeting space
cards.notes: Choose this named room for a scheduled collaboration block, especially when your group needs a defined start and finish.
cards.short_summary: A bookable shared meeting room within the Innovation Lab.
cards.evidence_claim: Innovation Lab Room 110 is listed among shared meeting spaces that students can reserve through the Outlook Calendar.
cards.access_notes: Students reserve this shared meeting space through the Outlook Calendar.

cards.title: Innovation Lab Room 111
cards.subtitle: Innovation Lab • shared meeting space
cards.notes: Reserve Room 111 for an intentional team work block and use the room’s flexible setup to match the task at hand.
cards.short_summary: A distinct, student-reservable shared room in the Innovation Lab.
cards.evidence_claim: Innovation Lab Room 111 is listed among shared meeting spaces that students can reserve through the Outlook Calendar.
cards.access_notes: Students reserve this shared meeting space through the Outlook Calendar.

cards.title: Innovation Lab Lobby Lounge
cards.subtitle: Innovation Lab • open lounge
cards.notes: Set up in the lobby lounge for informal individual or group work; move to a reservable room if your task needs privacy.
cards.short_summary: An open-lounge option inside S&T’s collaboration-oriented Innovation Lab.
cards.evidence_claim: The Innovation Lab building program includes a lobby lounge, open study areas, and collaboration spaces of several sizes.
cards.access_notes: Open-lounge availability is not guaranteed; check building access conditions on arrival.

cards.title: Kummer Atrium
cards.subtitle: Butler-Carlton Hall • 1401 N. Pine St.
cards.notes: Bring a solo task or meet a classmate at the atrium tables; shift plans if a scheduled event is using the gathering space.
cards.short_summary: An atrium with study tables and modern seating in Butler-Carlton Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T describes the Kummer Atrium as a gathering place with study tables and modern seating for students to meet and study.
cards.source_title: Facilities – Civil, Architectural and Environmental Engineering
cards.access_notes: The atrium is also used for events, so check the space on arrival.

cards.title: Havener Study Lounges
cards.subtitle: Havener Center • 1346 N. Bishop Ave.
cards.notes: Use one of Havener’s named study lounges between commitments; choose a different campus space when your work requires quiet isolation.
cards.short_summary: Named study-lounge spaces in S&T’s student-life center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Havener Center officially identifies Study Lounges as one of its study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Confirm building access and any event-related restrictions before settling in.

cards.title: Student Success Center
cards.subtitle: Innovation Lab Room 117 • 650 Tim Bradley Way
cards.notes: Work through course questions during drop-in tutoring or ask a success coach about study strategies, planning, and academic goals.
cards.short_summary: A staffed Innovation Lab hub for tutoring, study support, and success coaching.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Success Center in Innovation Lab Room 117 offers free peer tutoring, group study options, and success coaching.
cards.access_notes: Current posted hours: Mon–Thu 9 a.m.–6 p.m.; Fri 10 a.m.–4 p.m. Drop-in tutoring availability varies by course and schedule.

cards.title: Writing & Communication Center
cards.subtitle: Curtis Laws Wilson Library 314–315
cards.notes: Bring a draft, outline, slide deck, or speaking plan for feedback; use a walk-in during standard hours or schedule an evening appointment.
cards.short_summary: A library-based consultation space for writing, speaking, and presentation projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writing and Communication Center offers consultations for writing, speaking, and presenting ideas, with in-person tutoring in Curtis Laws Wilson Library Room 201 and its listed office at Room 314.
cards.access_notes: Walk-ins are welcome 9 a.m.–5 p.m. on open days; evening hours require an appointment. Verify the current room when booking.

warnings: The Writing and Communication Center’s current homepage lists in-person tutoring in Library Room 201 while its contact block lists Room 314; use its appointment system or contact the center to confirm the meeting location.
